detail.longDescription: Hello, Fediverse. I'm Ivo, a mechanical engineer in Croatia. I don't write code: I lead AI coding agents (Claude Code), check what they make and run it in my own house. Three projects came out of that, all self-hosted and source-available, free for personal use: OPUS: music, films, series and family photos BABA: an NVR for the house cameras DIDA: the smart home https:// boskovic.biz # introduction # selfhosted # homelab
